steps.what: Determine guidelines for acceptable source material based on mapping purpose and quality requirements

tasks.design: Keep setting source-acceptance guidelines with the cartographer and record their rationale in {DOCS}. Applying settled metadata checks can later be configured in the mapping system, but that is a separate task and supplies no saving here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Acceptability depends on intended map use, uncertainty and source limitations.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned guideline documents improve traceability without replacing criteria selection.
tasks.still_hard: A source can satisfy formal metadata requirements while being unsuitable for the intended use.
tasks.human_edge: The cartographer decides which errors matter and how conflicting quality requirements should be resolved.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in source-policy decision rights or assumed time.

reach.task: Explain source-quality requirements before data collection

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: determining mapping-source acceptance criteria is contextual judgement; automated application of settled criteria is a separate capability.

assumptions: Boundary covers defining and documenting guidelines, excluding repeated source-file validation and map compilation.

The cartographer gathers source examples and records purpose, scale, positional uncertainty, age, provenance, usage conditions and exceptions during counted s1. Missing requirements prompt manual consultation; no pre-existing acceptable-source flag is assumed.
Use native document templates and mapping metadata configuration before custom software. Existing automatic checks earn no labour credit in guideline design.
Zero incremental upkeep because no automated checker or additional recurring process is introduced.
unknowns: Map uses and required quality levels
Existing source-policy ownership and review cycle
research_questions: Is there separately measured repeated metadata checking after guidelines are settled?

already_counted.description: Assess requirements and define source guidelines

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine guideline revisions and unfamiliar source types both retain criteria-setting judgement; source-check execution is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select sensing methods and mapping equipment

steps.what: Select aerial photographic techniques, remote sensing methods and equipment against required accuracy

tasks.design: Keep method and equipment selection with the cartographer, using {DOCS} specifications and the {OTHER} geospatial planning system. Existing accuracy calculations inform the choice while the person weighs site conditions, limitations and practical feasibility.
tasks.previous_blocker: Accuracy depends on acquisition conditions and workflow assumptions as well as equipment specifications.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing geospatial planning calculations provide decision inputs without establishing faster expert selection.
tasks.still_hard: Nominal equipment accuracy may not describe the performance achievable on this site.
tasks.human_edge: The cartographer recognizes incompatible assumptions and chooses a defensible acquisition approach.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in selection responsibility or time assumptions.

reach.task: Specify control and uncertainty requirements for an acquisition plan

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selecting sensing and plotting methods requires contextual judgement; existing calculation runtime is not human labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the choice and its rationale, excluding equipment purchase, flight execution, survey measurements and subsequent adjustment.

The cartographer obtains required accuracy, coverage, terrain, capture conditions, control availability and equipment specifications during counted s1. Equipment suppliers produce specification sheets; survey staff produce any trial results before selection. Missing or incompatible evidence prompts manual verification rather than a presumed suitability flag.
The {OTHER} category is a geospatial planning system; inspect its native accuracy calculators before custom tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because this design introduces no new automation or recurring report.
unknowns: Existing accuracy-planning tools and validation practice
research_questions: Is any distinct repetitive comparison calculation still manual after native planning tools are used?

already_counted.description: Check specifications, assess feasibility and select the method

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Familiar equipment and difficult acquisition sites both retain contextual selection; pre-existing calculations earn no new credit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Source criteria and acquisition-method decisions retain their expert ownership and time.
reach: Discuss acquisition error budgets with geodetic specialists
role.ambitious_version: A cartographer who makes source and equipment choices explicit and defensible before mapping begins.
